seminar_2025.title: Current Topics in Visual & Circadian Neuroscience
seminar_2025.subtitle: Spring/summer 2025
seminar_2025.description: The Seminar Series "Current Topics in Visual & Circadian Neuroscience" was organised by the Translational Sensory & Circadian Neuroscience Unit (MPS/TUM/TUMCREATE) led by Prof. Dr. Manuel Spitschan. The 60-minute (45 min. talk + 15 min. Q&A/discussion) graduate-level seminars were free to join and took place via Zoom.
